head_commit.message:
Fix indexed fixture serialization across combined H1 and P1 sources

Preserve the concurrent console and Windows test-portability work. Use complete index-based array serialization in the three native fixtures and admit only the exact reversible fixture identities in the existing comparators. Preserve all historical variants, test criteria, production inputs and deadlines.
